verdict.rationale: Bento's docs say spans are captured over OpenTelemetry (bentolabs-docs-3, bentolabs-docs-29). You can point any OTel exporter at a single Bento endpoint with one auth header, and in TypeScript this needs no Bento package at all (bentolabs-docs-21). Bento can also wire directly into an existing OTel pipeline (bentolabs-docs-20), so ingestion is clearly standards-based rather than proprietary. Missing for 10: evidence of exporting or forwarding traces out of Bento over OTLP, explicit OTLP protocol/transport details (gRPC vs HTTP), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
